name: Grandma Crossing
steps: Tap the Grim Reaper to push him away.
Drag the soccer ball to the boy playing on the sidewalk.
Drag the cane to grandma so she can walk safely.
Drag the banana peel and trash into the garbage can.
Place the road cones around the open manhole.
Block the rolling fruit pile near the storefront.
Drag the red dog back onto its leash.
Stop the drunk driver in the red car.
Tap the broken pedestrian traffic light to turn it green.
Tap the angel clock in the center to unfreeze time and let grandma safely cross the road.
